        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/' followed
                by the owner's id. Derived from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived from the owner's own fields: the title
                followed by a single space and the lastName when a title is present
                (e.g. 'DR who'), otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                single space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. the stored
                '+61412345678' displays as '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the owner's own
                fields; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else
                UNKNOWN); FY is the two-digit fiscal year derived from the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated
                with lastName; and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits
                of <REGION><FY><HASH8>. Assigned at creation; '-<n>' is appended on
                collision.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year derived from the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is labelled by the
                calendar year in which it ends, so a registrationDate on or after 1 July
                falls in the following year's fiscal year (e.g. 1 July 2025 -> 'FY26').
                Null when no registrationDate is set. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household. Derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalized last name + '|' + postcode), so owners with the same last
                name and postcode always share it. Always assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A9C1D5E6B7A8C'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the moment this owner was created,
                sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
                Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership points, assigned at creation. Starts at 0;
                add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a
                household of 3 or more; add 3 for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal
                year. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation. Derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, taken from the REGION segment of the memberId (the
                region-and-hash identity, derived from the postcode). 'UNKNOWN' when no
                region could be derived. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC ->
                Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band at the moment of registration, derived from birthDate
                measured against registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to
                64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
                TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD';
                AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration business day at the moment this owner was created; false
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners at the
                moment this owner was created (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50);
                false otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A single summary flag, true when any soft-risk signal is present on the
                owner: the owner is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is true), the
                owner's email domain is disposable-adjacent (its second-level label matches
                a known disposable email service, e.g. a different TLD or a subdomain of
                mailinator/tempmail/guerrillamail), or the owner's city is over its soft
                capacity (capacityWarning is true); false otherwise. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single value all duplicate detection is expressed through: the
                lower-case hex SHA-256 over 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)'
                (the email segment is empty when absent). A create is rejected with 409 only
                when its whole identityKey equals an existing non-deleted owner's. Derived
                from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '3b8e0a1c2d4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, has an identityKey that
                differs from an existing owner's while its soundex(lastName) and postcode
                both match; false otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one softly matches (same soundex(lastName)
                and postcode, differing identityKey) when possibleDuplicate is true; null
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when this owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /owners/{id}; the
                record is retained rather than removed. False for a newly created owner.
                Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title. Optional. When present it drives the
            derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for
            backward compatibility, and also returned as the composed, normalized
            address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when present. Stored and returned normalized
            (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (e.g.
            unit or apartment). Stored and returned normalized when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted in national or
            international form (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored) and stored
            and returned in E.164 form: a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits. A national
            number with no country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading
            '0' dropped, so '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag, retained for backward compatibility. Duplicate detection is
            now expressed solely through the identityKey (SHA-256 over
            normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)); this flag no longer affects
            whether a create is rejected with 409 or flagged as a possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/' followed
                by the owner's id. Derived from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived from the owner's own fields: the title
                followed by a single space and the lastName when a title is present
                (e.g. 'DR who'), otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                single space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. the stored
                '+61412345678' displays as '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the owner's own
                fields; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else
                UNKNOWN); FY is the two-digit fiscal year derived from the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated
                with lastName; and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits
                of <REGION><FY><HASH8>. Assigned at creation; '-<n>' is appended on
                collision.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year derived from the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is labelled by the
                calendar year in which it ends, so a registrationDate on or after 1 July
                falls in the following year's fiscal year (e.g. 1 July 2025 -> 'FY26').
                Null when no registrationDate is set. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household. Derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalized last name + '|' + postcode), so owners with the same last
                name and postcode always share it. Always assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A9C1D5E6B7A8C'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the moment this owner was created,
                sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
                Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership points, assigned at creation. Starts at 0;
                add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a
                household of 3 or more; add 3 for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal
                year. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation. Derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, taken from the REGION segment of the memberId (the
                region-and-hash identity, derived from the postcode). 'UNKNOWN' when no
                region could be derived. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC ->
                Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band at the moment of registration, derived from birthDate
                measured against registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to
                64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
                TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD';
                AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration business day at the moment this owner was created; false
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners at the
                moment this owner was created (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50);
                false otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A single summary flag, true when any soft-risk signal is present on the
                owner: the owner is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is true), the
                owner's email domain is disposable-adjacent (its second-level label matches
                a known disposable email service, e.g. a different TLD or a subdomain of
                mailinator/tempmail/guerrillamail), or the owner's city is over its soft
                capacity (capacityWarning is true); false otherwise. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single value all duplicate detection is expressed through: the
                lower-case hex SHA-256 over 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)'
                (the email segment is empty when absent). A create is rejected with 409 only
                when its whole identityKey equals an existing non-deleted owner's. Derived
                from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '3b8e0a1c2d4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, has an identityKey that
                differs from an existing owner's while its soundex(lastName) and postcode
                both match; false otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one softly matches (same soundex(lastName)
                and postcode, differing identityKey) when possibleDuplicate is true; null
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when this owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /owners/{id}; the
                record is retained rather than removed. False for a newly created owner.
                Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets

  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

      parameters:

        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer

          content:

        404:

            application/json:

        500:

          content:
            application/json:
              schema:

        304:

        400:

        404:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title. Optional. When present it drives the
            derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for
            backward compatibility, and also returned as the composed, normalized
            address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when present. Stored and returned normalized
            (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (e.g.
            unit or apartment). Stored and returned normalized when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted in national or
            international form (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored) and stored
            and returned in E.164 form: a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits. A national
            number with no country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading
            '0' dropped, so '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag, retained for backward compatibility. Duplicate detection is
            now expressed solely through the identityKey (SHA-256 over
            normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)); this flag no longer affects
            whether a create is rejected with 409 or flagged as a possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/' followed
                by the owner's id. Derived from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived from the owner's own fields: the title
                followed by a single space and the lastName when a title is present
                (e.g. 'DR who'), otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code, a
                single space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. the stored
                '+61412345678' displays as '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the owner's own
                fields; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity contract this response is rendered under.
                Fixed at 2: the identifiers (memberId, identityKey, householdId) are grouped
                under 'identity' and are rederived with the version-2 algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year derived from the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is labelled by the
                calendar year in which it ends, so a registrationDate on or after 1 July
                falls in the following year's fiscal year (e.g. 1 July 2025 -> 'FY26').
                Null when no registrationDate is set. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household. Derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalized last name + '|' + postcode), so owners with the same last
                name and postcode always share it. Always assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A9C1D5E6B7A8C'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the moment this owner was created,
                sharing the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
                Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership points, assigned at creation. Starts at 0;
                add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a
                household of 3 or more; add 3 for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal
                year. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation. Derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, taken from the REGION segment of the memberId (the
                region-and-hash identity, derived from the postcode). 'UNKNOWN' when no
                region could be derived. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC ->
                Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band at the moment of registration, derived from birthDate
                measured against registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to
                64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
                TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD';
                AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration business day at the moment this owner was created; false
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners at the
                moment this owner was created (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50);
                false otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A single summary flag, true when any soft-risk signal is present on the
                owner: the owner is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is true), the
                owner's email domain is disposable-adjacent (its second-level label matches
                a known disposable email service, e.g. a different TLD or a subdomain of
                mailinator/tempmail/guerrillamail), or the owner's city is over its soft
                capacity (capacityWarning is true); false otherwise. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single value all duplicate detection is expressed through: the
                lower-case hex SHA-256 over 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)'
                (the email segment is empty when absent). A create is rejected with 409 only
                when its whole identityKey equals an existing non-deleted owner's. Derived
                from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '3b8e0a1c2d4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, has an identityKey that
                differs from an existing owner's while its soundex(lastName) and postcode
                both match; false otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one softly matches (same soundex(lastName)
                and postcode, differing identityKey) when possibleDuplicate is true; null
                otherwise. Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when this owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /owners/{id}; the
                record is retained rather than removed. False for a newly created owner.
                Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object

          type: integer
          format: int32

          example: 5
        totalElements:

          format: int64
          minimum: 0

          format: int32

          format: int32
          minimum: 0

        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements

          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages

    PetFields:

        - type

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - id
            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:

          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"

        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.

          items:

      required:
        - firstName

    Vet:

        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the vet.

              minimum: 0

      required:

    VisitFields:

      properties:

          description: The date of the visit.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        description:

          description: The description for the visit.

        - description
    Visit:

        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VisitFields'
        - type: object
          properties:

              description: The ID of the visit.

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            petId:
              title: Pet ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
            - petId
    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username
    Role:
      title: Role
      description: A role.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin
      required:
        - name

info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0

  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2

        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID

      parameters:

          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0

      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:

        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string

          description: Bad request.
          content:

              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:

                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:

        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details

      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32

            application/json:

          description: Bad request.

              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

          description: Owner not found.

            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

          required: true
          schema:

              description: An ID for this version of the response.

                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:

          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.

                type: string

          description: Bad request.

          description: Owner  not found.

            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The details of the new pet.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet was successfully added.
